notes:
{一眼|いちがん}レフ is the Japanese term for SLR (single-lens reflex) camera, a popular type among photography enthusiasts.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{一眼|いちがん}→一眼：08955_ichigan⟧ (single lens/eye)
- レフ (reflex, from German "Reflex")
- Full term: {一眼|いちがん}レフレックスカメラ

TYPES:
- {一眼|いちがん}レフ / SLR (traditional with mirror)
- ⟦ミラーレス→ミラーレス：24424_miraaresu⟧⟦{一眼|いちがん}→一眼：08955_ichigan⟧ (mirrorless) - newer technology
- ⟦デジタル→デジタル：05870_dejitaru⟧{一眼|いちがん}レフ / DSLR (digital SLR)

FEATURES:
- ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧{式|しき}⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧ (interchangeable lenses)
- {光学|こうがく}ファインダー (optical viewfinder)
- Larger sensors than compact cameras

COMMON BRANDS IN JAPAN:
- キヤノン (Canon)
- ニコン (Nikon)
- ソニー (Sony)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一眼|いちがん}レフ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧ (to shoot with an SLR)
- {一眼|いちがん}レフ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧ (lens for SLR)
